CO1: Build dictionaries with literals and the dict constructor, read, add, replace and remove their pairs, and predict the KeyError of a missing key
CO2: Choose among the in test, get, setdefault, pop and update to read or change a dictionary, and say which of them stores a value
CO3: Loop over keys, values and items, use views, sorted and reversed, and explain insertion order and why a dictionary may not change size inside its own loop
CO4: Count and group items with setdefault, Counter and defaultdict, and build dictionaries with comprehensions and the merge operators
CO5: Analyze how a dictionary models a real thing, which values are hashable keys, and how an alias, a shallow copy and a deep copy share inner data
